description: Election Commission - Supplementary Register of Electors - 2020 for the Displased and unregistert Citizens Elsewhere in the Island - Vauni District
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the preparation and public inspection of a supplementary register of electors for internally displaced citizens in the Vanni electoral district. It outlines procedures for appeals and objections related to voter registration, which directly pertains to electoral processes and voter registration matters as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
